context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository instructions and artifact safety rules.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; charts, HTML, and markdown reports are views only.
Missing metrics and missing evidence must be encoded explicitly, never fabricated.
P14 is opt-in only and must not be run or treated as automatic evidence.

context_files_read.purpose: Automatic phase boundary and CLI contract.
key_findings: Automatic completion stops at P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN requires explicit opt-in and is not a default real gate.
Reports must read artifacts rather than becoming the source of truth.

context_files_read.purpose: Loop execution expectations for stage work.
key_findings: Each stage must be recoverable, auditable, and harness-first.
Stage artifacts must record read context, subagent outputs, validation, result, commit, and push state.
Existing worktree changes must not be overwritten without recording a reason.

context_files_read.purpose: Harness priority, artifact-first rules, and anti-regression policy.
key_findings: Preferred L02 harness types are schema validation, artifact validation, committed artifact compatibility, CLI contract tests, and CI coverage tests.
Rendered reports must never be treated as source artifacts.
Historical artifact edits that hide missing provenance are forbidden.

context_files_read.purpose: L02 target scope and acceptance requirements.
key_findings: L02 must add or strengthen a provenance graph builder, DAG schema, source artifact hash check, and report-as-view tests.
P09 report, P11 stability report, and P12/P13 scale reports must trace back to source artifacts.
The graph output path is artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json.
L00 and L01 are PASS and pushed; L02 is the current stage.
L02 is expected to be static artifact validation, not a real Valkey or fault-wrapper run.
Missing provenance must become findings rather than historical artifact rewrites.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing committed-artifact audit semantics to reuse.
key_findings: Existing audit already loads the phase manifest, checks required artifacts, validates schemas, computes sha256, and distinguishes current, historical, and informational findings.
P13 historical gate command mismatch and legacy manifest sha drift are explicitly nonblocking when allowlisted.
P14 boundary logic verifies automatic=false, dry-run-only gates, opt-in guard, and absence of default real evidence.

context_files_read.purpose: Artifact schema inventory for graph node metadata and report coverage.
key_findings: Core artifact schemas consistently expose schema_version, artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, producer, status, and created_at where applicable.
report_index lists rendered report paths and sha256 values but does not define source provenance edges.

analysis_summary, stability_report, scale_ladder_report, p13_timing_breakdown, resource_preflight, valkey_e2e_evidence, cleanup_report, and phase_summary provide the primary machine-readable node types L02 must model.

context_files_read.purpose: Fixture style and expected audit finding behavior.
key_findings: Audit tests build isolated temporary repositories and assert exact blocking categories.
Existing tests cover empty JSON, missing artifacts, invalid JSONL, real evidence failures, P13 historical drift, and P14 dry-run boundary.
The L02 tests should follow the same fixture pattern for missing provenance and source hash drift.

context_files_read.purpose: CI expectations for committed artifact audit.
key_findings: CI expects the audit report to be generated and schema-valid.
The audit scope covers P00 through P13 and excludes P14 from automatic coverage.
P13 historical command mismatch remains nonblocking and must not cause the provenance graph to exclude P13.

context_files_read.purpose: Loop-engineering schema and workflow coverage expectations.
key_findings: Loop validation must remain available in CI.
The workflow must stay off P14 and real/fault wrapper scripts.
Subagent artifacts must validate against schemas/loop_engineering/subagent_response.schema.json.
P13 is intentionally excluded from this fast compatibility list because of historical command mismatch.
L02 provenance coverage must include P13 through the committed-artifact audit model rather than postcheck compatibility alone.
Validation should not refresh or rewrite historical gate artifacts.

context_files_read.purpose: Workflow command and safety boundary coverage.
key_findings: Existing GitHub coverage gate runs precheck, safety scan, and fast non-opt-in test families.
The workflow must not mention P14, VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, valkey_e2e_gate.py, fault_safety_gate.py, or fault_failover_gate.py.
L02 CI additions should run static provenance commands only.

context_files_read.purpose: Concrete P09/P11/P12/P13 required artifact paths and schemas.
key_findings: P09 required artifacts include phase_summary, analysis_summary, report_index, valkey_e2e_evidence, and cleanup_report.
P11 required artifacts include phase_summary, valkey_e2e_evidence, stability_report, and cleanup_report.
P12 and P13 required artifacts include resource preflight artifacts, per-rung real Valkey evidence, scale_ladder_report, cleanup_report, and phase_summary.

findings.description: The existing report and analysis schemas do not require provenance edges, so a separate DAG artifact and schema are required to enforce traceability without mutating historical phase artifacts.
evidence: schemas/artifact/report_index.schema.json requires reports[].path and reports[].sha256 only.
schemas/artifact/analysis_summary.schema.json allows arbitrary findings but has no source_artifacts contract.

findings.description: Rendered outputs in P09 report_index can be hash-checked, but they must be classified as report_view nodes with incoming source edges only.
evidence: artifacts/phases/P09_ANALYSIS_REPORTING/report_index.json lists CSV, SVG, Markdown, and HTML report outputs.
AGENTS.md says charts, HTML, and markdown reports are only views over versioned artifacts.

findings.description: P11 has a no-baseline state that should remain explicit rather than causing fabricated baseline edges.
evidence: L02 graph should still trace stability_report to stability_metrics.jsonl, valkey_e2e_evidence.json, cleanup_report.json, and the baseline comparison sidecar.

findings.description: P12 and P13 scale reports already cite real evidence paths, and the provenance harness must verify those paths, hashes, phases, run IDs, node counts, and schemas.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_graph_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json requiring schema_version, artifact_type=provenance_graph, created_at, producer, status, root_commit_sha, manifest_sha256, nodes, edges, phase_coverage, report_view_policy, summary, and findings. Nodes must include path, exists, sha256, artifact_role, artifact_type, phase_id, run_id, producer, schema_path, schema_sha256, and status where available. Edges must include source_path, target_path, relation, discovered_by, evidence_pointer, source_sha256, target_sha256, required, and status. Findings must include id, severity, category, blocking, description, evidence, and optional phase_id/path.

proposed_harness.name: build_provenance_graph_cli
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add scripts/build_provenance_graph.py with python3 scripts/build_provenance_graph.py --root . --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json. The command must scan codex/phase_manifest.json, required artifacts, gate results, audit decisions, report_index records, known sidecar artifacts, and report outputs; compute sha256 for every existing node; validate referenced report_index hashes; infer and validate source edges; detect cycles; and exit nonzero only when blocking current findings exist.

proposed_harness.name: source_artifact_hash_checks
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add tests/provenance/test_provenance_graph.py fixture coverage proving that every source and report_view node gets a sha256, report_index declared hashes are checked against file contents, and a declared or inferred source hash mismatch creates a blocking finding with category source_hash_mismatch or report_view_hash_mismatch.

proposed_harness.name: report_as_view_policy
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add fixture tests proving that .html, .md, .svg, and report-indexed CSV outputs are artifact_role=report_view, have no outgoing source-of-truth edges, and trigger report_view_used_as_source if any analysis or report tries to use a rendered view as an upstream source.

proposed_harness.name: missing_source_findings
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add fixture tests where analysis_summary, stability_report sidecars, or scale_ladder_report evidence_path references point at missing artifacts. The builder must keep the graph schema-valid and emit blocking findings with category missing_source_artifact, status MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, and the exact missing path.

proposed_harness.name: p09_p11_p12_p13_current_repo_coverage
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add a current-repository test that builds artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json and asserts coverage entries for P09_ANALYSIS_REPORTING, P11_STABILITY_SOAK, P12_SCALE_LADDER_10_30, and P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100. P09 report views must trace to analysis_summary, valkey_e2e_evidence, cleanup_report, and phase_summary. P11 stability_report must trace to stability_metrics.jsonl, stability_baseline_comparison.json, valkey_e2e_evidence, cleanup_report, and phase_summary. P12/P13 scale_ladder_report must trace to resource_preflight, per-rung valkey_e2e_evidence, cleanup_report, phase_summary, and P13 timing artifacts where present.

proposed_harness.name: provenance_ci_static_gate
proposed_harness.acceptance: Extend .github/workflows/github-coverage-gates.yml with static-only provenance commands: python3 scripts/build_provenance_graph.py --out artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json, python3 scripts/validate_json_schema.py --schema schemas/artifact/provenance_graph.schema.json --instance artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/provenance_graph.json, and python3 -m pytest -q tests/provenance tests/ci/test_provenance_graph_gate.py. The workflow must continue to omit P14 and real/fault wrapper gates.

implementation_plan.rationale: A standalone graph schema enforces provenance for historical artifacts without broadening existing phase schemas or rewriting committed evidence.

implementation_plan.step: Implement a deterministic static graph builder CLI.
implementation_plan.rationale: The builder should reuse script-local patterns from audit_committed_artifacts.py: Path-relative output, sha256_file, JSON/JSONL parsing, schema_validator.validate, finding IDs, P14 exclusion, and historical/current classification.

implementation_plan.step: Model graph nodes and source edges conservatively.
implementation_plan.rationale: Source-of-truth nodes are JSON/JSONL artifacts declared by the phase manifest or discovered as known sidecars. Rendered report outputs are report_view nodes. Edges flow only from source or derived machine-readable artifacts to derived artifacts or report views.
Temporary-repository fixtures can prove source hash checks, missing source findings, report-as-view enforcement, DAG acyclicity, and schema validity without touching historical artifacts.
L02 acceptance requires actual committed P09/P11/P12/P13 artifact coverage, including P13 despite its nonblocking historical gate command mismatch.

implementation_plan.step: Add CI workflow coverage for the static provenance gate.
implementation_plan.rationale: The provenance graph should be regenerated and schema-validated in CI while preserving the existing non-opt-in and no-real-wrapper boundaries.
The stage acceptance explicitly requires this path. The file must be builder-produced, schema-valid, and contain findings instead of patched historical evidence when provenance is absent.

acceptance_criteria: The graph contains nodes for all automatic P00-P13 required artifacts and excludes P14 from automatic coverage while recording P14 as optional dry-run boundary when represented.
Every existing graph node records sha256; every schema-backed node records schema_path and schema_sha256; missing nodes record exists=false and a MISSING finding rather than an invented hash.
P09 report_index report outputs are report_view nodes and have incoming edges from machine-readable artifacts; no rendered report node is allowed as a source-of-truth upstream.

P11 stability_report traces to stability_metrics.jsonl, stability_baseline_comparison.json, valkey_e2e_evidence.json, cleanup_report.json, and phase_summary.json. The no-baseline state remains SKIPPED_WITH_REASON or NO_BASELINE_YET.
P12 scale_ladder_report traces to resource_preflight_10.json, resource_preflight_30.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_10.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_30.json, cleanup_report.json, and phase_summary.json.

P13 scale_ladder_report traces to resource_preflight_50.json, resource_preflight_100.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_50.json, valkey_e2e_evidence_100.json, p13_timing_breakdown_scale_50.json, p13_timing_breakdown_scale_100.json, cleanup_report.json, and phase_summary.json.

Any source path referenced by analysis, stability, scale, report_index, audit decisions, or known sidecars that cannot be resolved creates a blocking missing_source_artifact finding unless the source is explicitly SKIPPED_WITH_REASON with reason and impact.
The CLI and tests are static-only and do not invoke scripts/valkey_e2e_gate.py, scripts/fault_safety_gate.py, scripts/fault_failover_gate.py, P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN, or VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Existing L00/L01 tests, committed artifact audit tests, loop validation, and fast CI checks remain compatible.
risks: Over-inference could make a report appear traceable when it only shares a phase directory; source edges must be based on explicit fields, known producer sidecars, manifest-required artifacts, or recorded audit declarations.
Under-inference could mark valid legacy artifacts as missing provenance; historical gaps should be represented as nonfabricated findings with clear categories and blocking policy.
Rendered CSV files inside report directories can look machine-readable; the builder should classify report-indexed CSV outputs as report_view unless they are also manifest-declared source artifacts.
P13 has known historical gate drift; the builder must include P13 provenance coverage without treating the drift as a reason to exclude P13.
P11 no-baseline data could be misread as missing evidence; the graph should preserve NO_BASELINE_YET and SKIPPED_WITH_REASON semantics.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not edit artifacts/gates, artifacts/phases, audit decisions, or historical reports to add provenance retroactively.
Do not make HTML, Markdown, SVG, report CSV, or screenshots source-of-truth nodes.
Do not hand-write PASS into provenance_graph.json or gate_result.json.
Do not mark missing source data as PASS or silently skip it without MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON reason text.
Do not run P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN, set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, or run real/fault wrapper gates for L02.
Do not weaken existing schemas, tests, CI commands, phase manifest requirements, or safety scans to make provenance pass.
notes: Harness design is static and artifact-first. It intentionally strengthens provenance around committed P09/P11/P12/P13 artifacts without requiring source/test edits in this subagent turn, without refreshing historical artifacts, and without invoking P14 or any real/fault wrapper gates.
